messages:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up: small global onboarding day Monday. 5 hires total (SF hub: 2, Remote: 3 — one in London). Two I-9s flagged for supporting docs; one remote needs local notary. Need badge printing, courier for kits, and one-on-one benefits for remote.
Owen R: I can cover badge escort 08:50 at kiosk 1. Please post final arrival list.
Nina T: I have the arrival list and printed name tents. IT-OPS: any blockers on laptop imaging?
IT-OPS: Imaging queued. Two devices finishing now; ETA 1.5h. We'll tag them ONB-LDN01/ONB-SF02.
CourierBot: Courier slot available AM-08. Recommend "OnboardExpress" label to speed desk handoff.
Priya (People Ops): Approve OnboardExpress. Nina, can you send kit list to courier? Include an extra notary envelope for London hire.
Nina T: Done. Courier pickup confirmed for 06:45 local. Added note: "notary envelope - require signature upon delivery".
BadgeBot: Badges ready for 3 hires. Two held pending I-9 confirmation. Template used: Quick-Visitor.
Owen R: For the London hire: who coordinates local notary? I can handle SF but not LDN.
Priya (People Ops): I'll book a NotaryNow vendor in London and add expenses to the onboarding charge code. Nina, include the notary appointment time in the calendar invite.
Security: Lobby hold OK 08:40-09:10. For remote notary in London, Security flagged that building access may need a temporary pass; Priya please provide guest codes.
Priya (People Ops): Guest codes added to invites. Also scheduling a 20m remote benefits intro at 14:00 PT for the remote hires. Nina will run it.
Nina T: Confirmed. I'll send Zoom and pre-read doc with benefits links.
Priya (People Ops): Final checklist: courier confirmed, notary booked, badges printing in progress, IT imaging on track. Post any last-minute escalations here before 18:00 PST. :white_check_mark:
